name: Isabelle Tremblay
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport began in her teens, fueled by a passion for engineering and a relentless curiosity about how things work. After graduating top of her class in mechanical engineering from McGill University, she quickly found her way into Formula SAE, where she led her team to multiple wins. This experience opened doors to professional racing, starting as a junior engineer at a small IndyCar team. She quickly impressed with her analytical skills and dedication, rising through the ranks to become a lead engineer. 

Isabelle believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement. She's known for her ability to translate complex technical information into actionable strategies for the race team. Her demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to excellence and a belief that pushing boundaries is the only way to achieve victory. She thrives in high-pressure environments and is always looking for innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. Having spent the last decade in IndyCar, she is now looking for a new challenge in Formula 1 or WEC.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with subtle layers framing her face
physical.description: Isabelle is a woman of average height with a focused gaze and a perpetually determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
